concept.name: Walk-forward analysis
concept.definition: Sequential evaluation that repeatedly fits or selects a model on past data and tests the frozen result on the next unseen time block.
concept.intuition: It estimates how a fitted choice behaves on observations that were not used to fit that choice.
concept.mechanics: Move the training and test boundaries forward, refit only on data preceding each test block, and concatenate the non-overlapping test results.
concept.failure_modes: Random splitting, overlapping labels, repeated tuning, or an unprotected final test set can produce optimistic estimates.
concept.misconceptions: Validation measures conditional generalization under a split design; it does not guarantee future market performance.
concept.example: Fit on 2018-2020 and test 2021, then fit on 2019-2021 and test 2022.
